newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gulf Cooperation Council chief carries peace proposal to Bahrain, which is locked in a border dispute with Qatar.
- GCC-U.S. talks in Riyadh on February 23 will focus on transfer of technology and joint ventures.
- Saudi seizes 136 tonnes of expired food in Jeddah.
- Travel papers of Indian children beggars to be processed soon.
- Saudi Arabia imports around 200,000 tonnes of aluminium a year.
